Selbst Partner- und kinderlos beobachtet sie, wie um sie herum an Familienplanung und der Optimierung von Lebensentwurfen gefeilt wird: Manner, wie ihr Chef, die mit uber 60 noch mal Vater werden, Frauen um die 50, die ihre Familien verlassen, um mit einem jungeren Mann noch mal ganz neu anzufangen oder Kolleginnen, die sich mit uber 40 ihren Kinderwunsch auch ohne Partner mit Hilfe von Samenbanken erfullen. Dafur hat Sophie kein Verstandnis. Auch wenn sie es nie zugeben wurde, hegt sie doch insgeheim den Wunsch, irgendwann einmal Kinder zu haben, aber nur mit dem Mann, den sie liebt. Als dem ungleichen Paar klar wird, wie unterschiedlich sie ticken, stellt sich die entscheidende Frage: Gibt es eine gemeinsame Zukunft? Und wenn ja, wer gibt nach? (Text: 3sat) Mit: Christiane Paul (Sophie Mehnert), Fritz Karl (Fritz Mertens), Ursula Strauss (Nina) u.v.a. Regie: Lars Jessen. DE 2015

programme.title: Almost perfectly in love / Fast perfekt verliebt
programme.desc: The life of engineer Isabel runs in a regulated path. It uses all its energy to the construction of a ship that is supposed to free the sea of ​​plastic mull. But her father Ernst worries her: after a stroke, he requires care. However, since he is difficult to satisfy, it does not endure a household help for a long time. By chance, father and daughter get to know Ivo at a celebration, who is immediately on a wave length with Ernst. Without knowing a lot about Ivo, Isabel hires him as a supervisor for her father. Text: ZDF. With Katharina Schuttler (Isabel Paulsen), Alexandar Jovanovic (Ivo Kordic), Manfred Zapatka (Ernst Paulsen), Carolyn Genzkow (Ewa). Directed by Sinan Akkusu. DE 2019 / Das Leben von Ingenieurin Isabel verlauft in geregelten Bahnen. Sie verwendet all ihre Energie auf die Konstruktion eines Schiffs, das die Meere von Plastikmull befreien soll. Doch ihr Vater Ernst bereitet ihr Sorgen: Nach einem Schlaganfall benotigt er Betreuung. Da er allerdings schwer zufriedenzustellen ist, halt es keine Haushaltshilfe lange bei ihm aus. Durch Zufall lernen Vater und Tochter auf einer Feier Ivo kennen, der mit Ernst gleich auf einer Wellenlange ist. Ohne viel uber Ivo zu wissen, stellt Isabel ihn kurzerhand als Betreuer fur ihren Vater ein. Text: ZDF. Mit Katharina Schuttler (Isabel Paulsen), Alexandar Jovanovic (Ivo Kordic), Manfred Zapatka (Ernst Paulsen), Carolyn Genzkow (Ewa). Regie: Sinan Akkusu. DE 2019

programme.title: The funny four of the petrol station / Die lustigen vier von der Tankstelle
programme.desc: Mr. Nesslauer's petrol station is no longer in demand because of the new motorway. A new lease is sought to the dismay of Michael and Gaby who work there. In addition to the freshly tuned television journalist Tommy, the little outer Nicki also joins the young people. Its actions will soon give the petrol station a lot of customers and sleepless nights. / Herrn Nesslauers Tankstelle ist wegen der neuen Autobahn nicht mehr gefragt. Zum Leidwesen von Michael und Gaby, die dort arbeiten, wird ein neuer Pachter gesucht. Neben dem frisch gekundigten Fernsehjournalisten Tommy gesellt sich auch der kleine AusreiSSer Nicki zu den jungen Leuten. Dessen Aktionen bescheren der Tankstelle bald jede Menge Kundschaft und den Behorden schlaflose Nachte.

programme.title: Hello taxi / Hallo Taxi
programme.desc: Leopold, a ground -based Viennese fiaker, cannot forgive his friend and colleague Franz that he has switched to the taxler industry. programme.title: My Style Rocks / My Style Rocks
programme.desc: The most spectacular fashion duel in the world finally in Germany! In the internationally successful fashion TV format "My Style Rocks" with moderator Gulcan Kamps, the stylish candidates pretend to be a prominently occupied expert: interior jury, the Harald Gloockler, Larissa Marolt and Sandra Bauknecht-to show their very special fashion taste and her unmistakable clothing. want to make the best impression. Who becomes Germany's most stylish woman? With a daily "style parade" and a big competition, a candidate will win the weekly price every week. At the end of the series, only one of them will be crowned as the most stylish woman in the country - and win the great prize money of 20,000 euros! / Das spektakularste Fashion-Duell der Welt endlich auch in Deutschland! In dem international erfolgreichen Fashion-TV-Format "My Style Rocks" mit Moderatorin Gulcan Kamps prasentieren sich die stylischen Kandidatinnen vor einer prominent besetzten Expert:innen-Jury, der Harald Gloockler, Larissa Marolt, Andreas Wendt und Sandra Bauknecht angehoren - um ihren ganz besonderen Modegeschmack und ihren unverwechselbaren Kleidungsstil zu zeigen, mit dem sie den besten Eindruck machen wollen. Wer wird Deutschlands stylischste Frau? Mit einer taglichen "Style Parade" und einem groSSen Wettbewerb wird jede Woche eine Kandidatin den Wochen-Preis gewinnen. Am Ende der Serie wird nur eine von ihnen als die stilvollste Frau des Landes gekront werden - und das groSSe Preisgeld von 20.000 Euro gewinnen!

programme.title: Container Wars / Container Wars
programme.desc: From now on, it is also made in the port: In the new series "Container Wars", the content of large ship containers from all over the world comes under the hammer. In this rapid business, however, not only a thick wallet is needed, but also a good eye and iron nerves to be successful. The auctioners only have a few minutes to get a first impression of the container. Therefore, you only know after the auction whether it was worth it or not. John Kunkle, who always has one or the other saying ready. The Israeli entrepreneur duo Shlomi and Uzi, the charming Sudlander Jason, the two Californians Ty and Mo, the experienced Matthew and the former Schonheitkonigin Deana, who wants to assert himself in the manner, are entitled to the bidders. / Ab sofort werden auch im Hafen Geschafte gemacht: In der neuen Serie "Container Wars" kommt der Inhalt von groSSen Schiffscontainern aus der ganzen Welt unter den Hammer. In diesem rasanten Business braucht es allerdings nicht nur einen dicken Geldbeutel, sondern auch ein gutes Auge und eiserne Nerven, um Erfolg zu haben. Den Auktionaren bleiben nur wenige Minuten, um sich einen ersten Eindruck vom Inhalt der Container zu verschaffen. Daher weiSS man auch erst nach der Versteigerung, ob sich das Geschaft gelohnt hat oder nicht. Die Auktionen ubernimmt die lokale Beruhmtheit John Kunkle, der immer den einen oder anderen Spruch parat hat. Zu den Bietern gehoren das israelische Unternehmer-Duo Shlomi und Uzi, der charmante Sudlander Jason, die beiden Kalifornier Ty und Mo, der erfahrene Matthew und die ehemalige Schonheitskonigin Deana, die sich in der Mannerdomane behaupten will.

Keine der Frauen ahnt, dass er nach seiner Haftentlassung etliche Morde begangen hat.Die Polizei hat ihn trotz seiner Vorstrafen zunachst nicht im Visier, sondern ordnet die von ihm begangenen Morde einem anderen Serienkiller zu. Alacala kann seine Spuren immer wieder verwischen und fuhlt sich den Strafverfolgern so uberlegen, dass er sogar in der landesweit ausgestrahlten TV-Flirtshow "The Dating Game" als Kandidat auftritt. Als er schlieSSlich festgenommen wird, kann man ihm funf Morde nachweisen. Doch angesichts der gefundenen Fotos gehen die Ermittler von weit mehr Opfern aus.Sex, Mord und Skandale - in dieser zehnteiligen Reihe geht es um einige der spektakularsten Verbrechen der letzten Jahrzehnte. Kriminalfalle voller Tragik, Grausamkeit und unendlichem Leid.Ob mordende Sportstars, Serienkiller oder Sex mit Minderjahrigen, die Reihe beschaftigt sich mit den tiefsten Abgrunden der Kriminalgeschichte. Zeitzeugen, Experten und Betroffene schildern die Falle aus ihrer Sicht und klaren dabei so manche ungeloste Frage auf.

programme.title: Putin's apprenticeship - from the back yard to power / Putins Lehrjahre - Vom Hinterhof an die Macht
programme.desc: Vladimir Putin has been the strong man of Russia for 25 years. His career starts in a time of the transition: the dying Soviet Union. With connections to the underworld and to rope teams from the secret service, he steps on the way to power. Als Agent erlebt Putin den Zusammenbruch des Kommunismus in der DDR: Fur Putin endet damals mehr als nur ein System. Fur ihn bricht eine Welt zusammen. programme.title: Electra K3 E7 (E) / Ηλέκτρα Κ3 Ε7 (Ε)
programme.desc: Harris receives an anonymous note that calls him to the yard and is not the only one who will be there. With so many questions unanswered and a killer free, Brettos decides to formalize his resurrection. / Ο Χάρης λαμβάνει ένα ανώνυμο σημείωμα που τον καλεί στο ναυπηγείο και δεν είναι ο μόνος που θα βρεθεί εκεί. Με τόσα ερωτήματα αναπάντητα κι έναν δολοφόνο ελεύθερο, ο Βρεττός αποφασίζει να επισημοποιήσει την ανάστασή του.

programme.title: Pop cooking K9 / ΠΟΠ Μαγειρική Κ9
programme.desc: Episode: Katerina Misichron. . Together with chef Andreas Lagos, Katerina Misichroni leaves the board for a while and explores the scene of taste. Rubber from the Axios Delta and juicy watermelons from Ios are combined to recipes full of freshness. / Επεισόδιο: Κατερίνα Μισιχρόνη. . Μαζί με τον σεφ Ανδρέα Λαγό, η Κατερίνα Μισιχρόνη αφήνει για λίγο το σανίδι και εξερευνά τη σκηνή της γεύσης. Αυγοτάραχο από το Δέλτα του Αξιού και ζουμερά καρπούζια από την Ίο συνδυάζονται σε συνταγές γεμάτες φρεσκάδα.

programme.title: Studio 4 / Στούντιο 4
programme.desc: Nancy Zambetoglou and Thanassis Anagnostopoulos are returning for the fifth year to talk about everything that concerns us, inspire, entertain us or move us. / H Νάνσυ Ζαμπέτογλου και ο Θανάσης Αναγνωστόπουλος επιστρέφουν για πέμπτη χρονιά για να μιλήσουν για όλα όσα μας απασχολούν, μας εμπνέουν, μας διασκεδάζουν ή μας συγκινούν.

programme.title: Central News Bulletin - Sports - Weather / Κεντρικό Δελτίο Ειδήσεων - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: With correspondents in every corner of Greece and around the world, the ERT Central News Bulletin brings to every home everyday reporting, extraordinary news, and what affects our lives. / Με ανταποκριτές σε κάθε γωνιά της Ελλάδας και σε όλο τον κόσμο το κεντρικό δελτίο ειδήσεων της ΕΡΤ μεταφέρει σε κάθε σπίτι το καθημερινό ρεπορτάζ, τις έκτακτες ειδήσεις, αλλά και όσα επηρεάζουν τη ζωή μας.

programme.title: Alas for young people / Αλίμονο στους Νέους
programme.desc: An old man sells his soul to the devil in order to win a few years of youth that will allow him to conquer the heart of his beloved. (89) / Ένας γέρος πουλάει την ψυχή του στο διάβολο προκειμένου να κερδίσει λίγα χρόνια νεότητας που θα του επιτρέψουν να κατακτήσει την καρδιά της αγαπημένης του. (89)

programme.title: Electra K3 E8 / Ηλέκτρα Κ3 Ε8
programme.desc: Memories are plaguing Nefeli. She struggles to find the truth they don't tell her. And she hides her secret. In her. Electra wakes up in Paul's arms. / Οι μνήμες ταλανίζουν τη Νεφέλη. Παλεύει να βρει την αλήθεια που δεν της λένε. Κι εκείνη κρύβει, όμως, το μυστικό της. Μέσα της. Η Ηλέκτρα ξυπνά στην αγκαλιά του Παύλου.

programme.title: The E8 child / Το Παιδί Ε8
programme.desc: Vana returns home, however, having forgotten Susie and awakens in Artemis her childhood wounds. Dimitri and Anthoula decide to solve a new mystery together. / Η Βάνα επιστρέφει σπίτι ανανεωμένη έχοντας, όμως, ξεχάσει τη Σούζι και το γεγονός ξυπνάει στην Άρτεμη τραύματα της παιδικής της ηλικίας. Ο Ντιμίτρι και η Ανθούλα αποφασίζουν να λύσουν μαζί ένα νέο μυστήριο.

programme.title: Necessary E2 light / Απαραίτητο Φως Ε2
programme.desc: Louisa decides to complete her father's research with the help of Peter, while making an effort to make the relationship between them. Grandma serves as a volunteer nurse and knows the one who put her in the resistance. / Η Λουΐζα αποφασίζει να ολοκληρώσει την έρευνα του πατέρα της, με τη βοήθεια του Πέτρου, ενώ κάνει μια προσπάθεια να φτιάξει η μεταξύ τους σχέση. Η γιαγιά υπηρετεί ως εθελόντρια νοσοκόμα και γνωρίζει αυτόν που την έβαλε στην Αντίσταση.

programme.title: Bone collector / Συλλέκτης Οστών
programme.desc: A killer is released on the streets of Manhattan. The creepy traces he leaves in every place of crime seem to be secret ... Who can understand the messages? Who is enough to play with him? (115) / Ένας δολοφόνος κυκλοφορεί ελεύθερος στους δρόμους του Μανχάταν. Τα ανατριχιαστικά ίχνη που αφήνει σε κάθε τόπο του εγκλήματος μοιάζουν να έχουν κρυφή σημασία... Ποιός μπορεί να κατανοήσει τα μηνύματα; Ποιός είναι αρκετά ικανός να παίξει μαζί του; (115)

programme.desc: After the first night of the wedding, Maritina tries to expel Tonia but does not succeed. Piperopoulos threatens Manos to tell him if he was teased his little girl the night before, and Manos categorically denies it. / Η Μαριτίνα μετά το φιάσκο της πρώτης νύχτας του γάμου προσπαθεί να διώξει την Τόνια αλλά δε τα καταφέρνει. Ο Πιπερόπουλος απειλεί τον Μάνο να του πει αν πείραξε το προηγούμενο βράδυ το κοριτσάκι του κι ο Μάνος το αρνείται κατηγορηματικά.

programme.title: In foreign hands E31 (e) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε31 (Ε)
programme.desc: With his father's plans to fail one behind the other, Manos is more determined than ever to get the situation in his hands. Η Πελαγία, με τη βοήθεια της Μάρως, προσπαθεί να λύσει το μυστήριο της Δ.Φ.

programme.desc: Episode: Costas Voutsas, The Unknown History. programme.title: Front line / Linha da Frente

programme.title: The Law of Teerao / A Lei de Teerao
programme.desc: Samad, police officer at the Narcotic Brigade in Teerao, looks for a dangerous local drug cheap, Nasser Khakzad. After many attempts, you can find it by finding it after a failed suicide attempt. While Nasser goes through the legal procedures that will lead him to the death penalty and execution, Samad begins to realize that it was the social conditions and the completely corrupt institutions of society that forced Nasser to the criminal life it led. The arrests and executions he made in his career then begin to present themselves as useless and without any impact on the drug problem in the Irao. What seemed to be a victory becomes the beginning of an unexpected and dangerous confrontation that will change their lives forever. Making a portrait of a question rarely addressed in Iranian cinema, Saeed Rousa dives into the obscure world of drug trafficking and calls attention to the exponential increase in the number of toxicode dependents, many of which shelter, for the ease of drug access and the disability of police forces in combating this epidemic. / Samad, agente de polícia na brigada de narcoticos em Teerao, procura um perigoso barao de droga local, Nasser Khakzad. Depois de muitas tentativas, consegue localizá-lo, encontrando-o apos uma tentativa de suicídio falhada. Enquanto Nasser passa pelos procedimentos legais que o levarao à pena de morte e à execuçao, Samad começa a perceber que foram as condições sociais e as instituições completamente corruptas da sociedade que forçaram Nasser à vida criminosa que levou. As detenções e execuções que fez na sua carreira começam entao a apresentar-se como algo inútil e sem qualquer impacto no problema de droga no Irao. O que parecia ser uma vitoria torna-se o início de um confronto inesperado e perigoso que mudará as suas vidas para sempre. Fazendo um retrato de uma questao poucas vezes abordada no cinema iraniano, Saeed Roustaee mergulha no mundo obscuro do narcotráfico e chama a atençao para o aumento exponencial do número de toxicodependentes, muitos dos quais sem abrigo, para a facilidade do acesso à droga e para a incapacidade das forças policiais no combate a esta epidemia.

programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. programme.title: Football - Carabao Cup: Port Vale - Arsenal / Fudbal - Carabao Cup: Port Vale - Arsenal
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike its popular FA Cup brother, starts its history in the 1960s and 20th centuries using the possibility of playing under the spotlight in the evening hours it was not possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg brata FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. programme.title: For the Federal - Liga Evrope: Braga - Fineenoror / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Braga - Feyenoord
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football (m): din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, European League 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, Evropska liga 2025/26
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFA since 1971. The non -deputy predecessor of this competition has been the Cup of the Vele Tezje cities, which took place between 1955 and 1971. Since then, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that purpose. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season, groups of eliminations have been introduced. The Cup was designed in 1972 by Italian artist Bertoni for the UEFE Cup Finals and is awarded every year to the winner, with a year left. / Drugo najprestižnejše klubsko nogometno tekmovanje v Evropi je uradno pod okriljem Evropske nogometne zveze Uefe od leta 1971. Neslužbeni predhodnik tega tekmovanja je bil Pokal velesejemskih mest, kateri se je odvijal med letoma 1955 in 1971. Od takrat naprej se tekmovanje uradno imenuje Pokal Uefe in pod tem namenom se odvija vse do leta 2009, ko je bil preimenovan v Evropsko ligo. Skozi leta se je sam format tekmovanja nekajkrat spremenil, od sezone 2004/2005 pa je uvedeno tekmovanje po skupinah, kateremu sledijo eliminacije. Pokal je leta 1972 dizajniral italijanski umetnik Bertoni za finale Pokala Uefe in vsako leto ga dodelijo zmagovalcu, pri katerem ostane leto dni.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - NK Bravo, Prvaliga 2025/2026, First League / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - NK Bravo, PrvaLiga 2025/2026, Prva Liga
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFA since 1971. Od takrat naprej se tekmovanje uradno imenuje Pokal Uefe in pod tem namenom se odvija vse do leta 2009, ko je bil preimenovan v Evropsko ligo. Skozi leta se je sam format tekmovanja nekajkrat spremenil, od sezone 2004/2005 pa je uvedeno tekmovanje po skupinah, kateremu sledijo eliminacije. programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. programme.title: Formula 1: VN Saudi Arabia: Race, Pos. / Formula 1: VN Savdske Arabije: Dirka, pos.

programme.title: Formula 1: VN Miami: Race, Pos. / Formula 1: VN Miamija: Dirka, pos.
programme.desc: The racing cream has gathered in Florida, where they take 57 rounds at the Miami International Autodrome race and compete for the title of the best. programme.title: Formula 1: VN Emilie Romagne: Dirka, POS. / Formula 1: VN Emilie Romagne: Dirka, pos.

programme.title: F1: vn Monte Carlo: Dirka, post. / F1: VN Monte Carlo: Dirka, pos.

Zvezdnik te steze je pokojni Ayrton Senna, z nami pa si oglejte, kdo se bo v tokratni...

programme.title: Formula 1: VN Spain: Race, Pos. / Formula 1: VN Španije: Dirka, pos.

programme.title: Environments, pom. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambienti; Mlad par si je ustvaril svoj sanjski dom v novogradnji na očarljivem Bledu. Pot od iskanja idealne lokacije do končne ureditve doma ni bila kratka, vendar dom zdaj popolnoma odraža njune želje po udobju in estetiki. Spoznamo, kako sta se sooča
programme.desc: We show an apartment in Portorož that goes beyond the boundaries of countries and combines people with a vision of beauty and harmony. The background of harmonious chaos consists of artistic pieces from all over the world - from Iran and Uzbekistan all the way to local antiques. The owner explains how she succeeded in subtly combining the stories of the past with modernity and what role her partner plays. Although dry meadows above the Karst edge are considered to be the most colorful collection of meadow flowers, just below it is a beautiful garden, completely hidden from the rare visitors of the village of Podpeč. His creator kindly received us and took us around her stone home, surrounded by dehuminous roses, fruit trees and countless flowers. / Pokažemo stanovanje v Portorožu, ki presega meje držav ter združuje ljudi z vizijo lepote in harmonije. Ozadje harmoničnega kaosa sestavljajo umetniški kosi z vseh koncev sveta - od Irana in Uzbekistana pa vse do lokalnih starinarnic. Lastnica razloži, kako ji je uspelo subtilno združiti zgodbe preteklosti s sodobnostjo in kakšno vlogo pri tem igra njen partner.Čeprav veljajo suhi travniki nad Kraškim robom za najbolj pisano zbirko travniških cvetlic, se tik pod njim skriva čudovit vrt, povsem skrit očem redkih obiskovalcev vasi Podpeč. Njegova ustvarjalka nas je prijazno sprejela in popeljala okoli svojega kamnitega doma, obdanega z dehtečimi vrtnicami, sadnimi drevesi in neštetimi cvetovi.

To nicer: Logar Valley and Harvest, Mon. / Na lepše: Logarska dolina in trgatev, pon.
programme.sub-title: Obiskali smo eno najlepših alpskih dolin v Evropi, kjer že več kot pol tisočletja živi in ustvarja rodbina Plesnik. Plesniki so izgradili sedanji hotel, ki je tekom zgodovine pomembno vplival na turistični razvoj Logarske doline in tudi na razvoj gorniš
programme.desc: The team of the show to nicer climbed the Rinka Waterfall to Okrešelj, where the renovated Frishauf Home is created. With mountain rescuers, they continued to go under the wall of Turkish Mountain, to the space of a tragic ambulance accident, which occurred in 1997 and is considered one of the worst tragedies in the almost centuries-old history of the Slovenian Mountain Research Service. The show also harvests in the heart of Slovenian Istria, in the village of Truška, from where the view of the Bay of Trieste and the valley of the Dragonja River opens. What was this year's harvest and how wine tourism and expectations and guest demand have changed over the last decade. / Ekipa oddaje Na lepše se je mimo slapa Rinka povzpela tudi na Okrešelj, kjer nastaja prenovljeni Frishaufov dom. Z gorskimi reševalci pa so se odpravili še naprej pod ostenje Turske gore, k prostoru tragične nesreče reševalcev, ki se je zgodila leta 1997 in velja za eno najhujših tragedij v skoraj stoletni zgodovini slovenske gorsko-reševalne službe. V oddaji pa tudi trgatvi v osrčju slovenske Istre, v vasici Truške od koder se odpira pogled na Tržaški zaliv in dolino reke Dragonje. Kakšna je bila letošnja letina in kako se je v zadnjem desetletju spremenil vinski turizem in pričakovanja ter povpraševanje gostov.

programme.desc: THE JOOVAHS WITNESESS: THE INSIDE STORY / LÉNIGMMENT TÉMOINS THE YOUR / THAT HOVAS: GOT, GOTTY / Francija / Francija / Francija / 2023 . / THE JEHOVAHS WITNESSES: THE INSIDE STORY / LÉNIGME DES TÉMOINS DE JÉHOVAH / DIE ZEUGEN JEHOVAS: GOTT, GELD UND GEHORSAM / Francija / 2023 / Režija: Vincent Nequache.

programme.title: Let's listen to the silence: SZJ is soon an official part of the school system, Mon. / Prisluhnimo tišini: SZJ kmalu uradno del šolskega sistema, pon.
programme.desc: The next school year is expected to formally enter the school for the first time. This will allow many deaf and hard of hearing children to learn about their language in their own language, which is a major step forward. Until then, their main support will be interpreted in schools, and in some schools there will be a positive spark, for example, they offer sign language as an optional content. The history of the deaf education proves that it was not always easy for them. In the second half of the 19th century, the use of sign language in schools was prohibited, and children had to learn by oral or speech method. You are invited to watch the show Listen to Silence, which will be scheduled 24. 9. At 3:40 pm on the first program of Television Slovenia. / Prihodnje šolsko leto naj bi slovenski znakovni jezik prvič uradno vstopil v šole. To bo mnogim gluhim in naglušnim otrokom omogočilo, da se bodo o svojem jeziku učili v svojem jeziku, kar predstavlja velik korak naprej. Do takrat bodo v šolah njihova glavna opora tolmači, v nekaterih šolah pa že tli pozitivna iskrica, saj denimo ponujajo znakovni jezik kot izbirno vsebino. Zgodovina izobraževanja gluhih dokazuje, da jim ni bilo vedno lahko. V drugi polovici 19. stoletja je bila uporaba znakovnega jezika v šolah prepovedana, otroci so se morali učiti po oralni ali govorni metodi. programme.title: Bite Science: Radioactive followers, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Radioaktivna sledila, pon.
programme.desc: The Hungarian chemist and Nobel laureate Georg von Hevesy, as a young student, suspected that his housewife was preparing dishes from several days old remains. In order to prove this, he sprinkled food with a radioactive trace, and when he served the same food, he checked with a detector that he was radioactive. His suspicions were confirmed. This was the first use of radioactive followed. Today, this method is something quite common. We can follow molecules in plants, in our body, monitoring the movement of fish flocks, sea currents. Radioactive followed us reveal ways that we would not otherwise see. They can also protect endangered animals and valuables. / Madžarski kemik in Nobelov nagrajenec Georg von Hevesy je kot mlad študent sumil, da mu njegova gospodinja pripravlja jedi iz več dni starih ostankov. Da bi to dokazal, je hrano posipal z radioaktivnim sledilom, in ko mu je postregla isto hrano, z detektorjem preveril, ali je radioaktivna. Njegovi sumi so bili potrjeni. To je bila prva uporaba radioaktivnih sledil. Danes je ta metoda nekaj povsem običajnega. Sledimo lahko molekulam v rastlinah, v našem telesu, spremljamo gibanje ribjih jat, morskih tokov. Radioaktivna sledila nam razkrivajo poti, ki jih sicer ne bi videli. Z njimi pa lahko tudi varujemo ogrožene živali in dragocenosti.

programme.desc: The film tells the story of Gertrude Bell, who, as a historian, writer and member of the British secret intelligence service in the 1920s, played a key role in the formation of a new political order in the Middle East. Following a tragic relationship with a diplomat and an unwavering gambler Henry Cadogan, he decides to put his private life on the sidelines and discover the country as a researcher. While the Ottoman Empire is slowly falling apart, Gertrude Bell learns languages, translates literature, learns Muslim dignitaries in Cairo, Basra and Baghdad, and gains their confidence with his courage and respect. As a mediator between the Orient and the British Empire after the First World War, she contributes to the determination of new borders in the country. Original title: Queen of the Desertleto Production: 2015 Spring: USA, Morocagulus: Biographical Film Studies: Werner Herzogscenario: Werner Herzogigrada: Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis. / Film pripoveduje zgodbo o Gertrude Bell, ki je kot zgodovinarka, pisateljica in članica Britanske tajne obveščevalne službe v 20. letih prejšnjega stoletja odigrala ključno vlogo pri oblikovanju novega političnega reda na Bližnjem vzhodu. Po tragičnem razmerju z diplomatom in nepoboljšljivim kockarjem Henryjem Cadoganom se odloči, da postavi zasebno življenje na stranski tir in deželo odkrije kot raziskovalka. Medtem ko Otomansko cesarstvo počasi razpada, se Gertrude Bell uči jezikov, prevaja literaturo, spoznava muslimanske dostojanstvenike v Kairu, Basri in Bagdadu ter s svojim pogumom in spoštljivostjo pridobi njihovo zaupanje. Kot mediatorka med Orientom in Britanskim imperijem po prvi svetovni vojni prispeva k določanju novih meja v deželi. programme.title: Mussolini - fascist dictator, French documentary series, 1/2, Mon. / Mussolini – fašistični diktator, francoska dokumentarna serija, 1/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, Le Premier Fasciste; Utelesil je zavezništvo med fašistično Italijo in nacistično Nemčijo ter zavladal ljudstvu kot novi cezar in dedič cesarskega Rima. Dokumentarna serija v dveh delih predstavi zgodbo o duče
programme.desc: Part 1: Benito Mussolini was born in a poor village near Venice. As a young man, he repeatedly landed behind the latch due to the revolutionary incitement. He then transformed into a nationalist. Determined to turn Italy into a world superpower modeled after the Roman Empire, Mussolini took power in 1922 after a march to Rome and introduced fascism into the country. He ruled with a hard hand, but the Italians, as well as the Italian Jews, admired him, promising them the rebirth of the country. His regime was also inspired by Adolf Hitler, who became a Firer of Germany in 1933. Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, only the Prime Minister of the Fascist / France / 2021 / Director: Serge de Sampignny. / 1. del:Benito Mussolini se je rodil v revni vasici blizu Benetk. Kot mladenič je zaradi revolucionarnega hujskaštva večkrat pristal za zapahi. Nato se je prelevil v nacionalista. Odločen, da Italijo spremeni v svetovno velesilo po vzoru rimskega cesarstva, je Mussolini leta 1922 po pohodu na Rim prevzel oblast in v državo vpeljal fašizem. Vladal je s trdo roko, toda Italijani, pa tudi italijanski Judje, so ga občudovali, saj jim je obljubljal preporod države. Njegov režim pa je navdihnil tudi Adolfa Hitlerja, ki je leta 1933 postal firer Nemčije. MUSSOLINI, THE FASCIST EMPEROR / MUSSOLINI, LE PREMIER FASCISTE / Francija / 2021 / Režija: Serge de Sampigny.

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: Lenart Krečič and Big Band RTV Slovenia, guests Gene Lake and Boris Kozlov, Max Club Jazz Festival Velenje, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: Lenart Krečič in Big Band RTV Slovenija, gosta Gene Lake in Boris Kozlov, Max Klub Jazz Festival Velenje, pon.
programme.desc: R: Švigelj Tomaž ... At the opening concert of the Jazz Max Club Festival in Velenje, young Slovenian jazz creator Lenart Krečič presented himself with an author's program in the company Big Banda RTV Slovenia and two music guests. The saxophonist, arranger and composer, torn between the US and Slovenia, has lived and worked for seven years in New York, a metropolis of jazz music. At a highly respected university, he completed his master's degree in improvisation, he had the opportunity to get to know and create with many giants of jazz music and perform in numerous renowned jazz clubs, including Blue Note, Iridium and Jazz Gallery. He brought two excellent guest musicians, American drummer Gen Lak and bassist Boris Kozlov, who is native to Russian, and live and work in New York to New York. The program, prepared and led by Lenart Krečič, was featured with seven author's songs written right for the occasion and performers. / R: Švigelj Tomaž... Na otvoritvenem koncertu Jazz festivala Max kluba v Velenju se je z avtorskim programom v družbi Big Banda RTV Slovenija in dveh glasbenih gostov predstavil mladi slovenski džezovski ustvarjalec Lenart Krečič. Saksofonist, aranžer in skladatelj, razpet med ZDA in Slovenijo, je v New Yorku, metropoli džezovske glasbe, živel in deloval kar sedem let. Na zelo cenjeni univerzi je končal magistrski študij iz improvizacije, imel je priložnost spoznati in ustvarjati s številnimi velikani džezovske glasbe in nastopiti v številnih priznanih džezovskih klubih, med drugimi v Blue note, Iridium in Jazz Gallery. Na tokratni koncert v Slovenijo je pripeljal dva izvrstna gostujoča glasbenika, ameriškega bobnarja Gena Laka in basista Borisa Kozlova, ki je po rodu Rus, živi in deluje pa v New Yorku. programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Sense fiction: Question-Ho to Dr. Ruth / Sense ficcio: Pregunta-ho a la Dra. Ruth
programme.desc: This documentary chronicles the life of Ruth Westheimer, a Jewish woman who was an orphan when he was a Lholocaust and as an adult, became the most famous sexual sex therapist in the United States. With a direct and blunt approach to sexuality, Dr. Ruth changed the way of speaking this topic in the late 20th century American society. About 90 years old and with an energy that seems inexhaustible, the protagonist of the documentary tells us the various stages of his life and the path that led him to the first media line. / Aquest documental narra la vida de la Ruth Westheimer, una dona jueva que de petita va quedar òrfena a causa de lHolocaust i de gran va arribar a ser la terapeuta sexual mes famosa dels Estats Units. Amb un enfocament directe i sense embuts de la sexualitat, la Dra. Ruth va canviar la manera de parlar daquest tema en la societat americana de finals del segle XX. A punt de fer 90 anys i amb una energia que sembla inesgotable, la protagonista del documental ens explica les diverses etapes de la seva vida i el camí que la va portar fins a primera línia mediàtica.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut / SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: Two years ago, his left toe stuck in the spines of the most poisonous fish in Europe, in Petermann. Today Philipp Kunz from Munchenstein BL was spared on this species and serves it to his four colleagues - to the main course of notaing. You can of course get the Petermannchen served without the poisonous backstreams, so garnished with memories of the painful bathing holidays in France. Philipp Kunz is the ambitious in the team. Only a kase plate or a piece of meat that the guest still has to fry as an imposition does not come on the table with him. Self-Made is his motto, and the project manager of a telecommunications company comes up with a lot: be it the light curry lemon grass soup next to the Tatar from Bundnerfleisch, the Cicorino-Rosseo risotto, the rosemary parfait or the homemade Florentine. With the intent "The winner I am", the 46-year Basel bidder stands to the stove-well prepared with all its notes and drawings. Is it really noted on that? An ambitious hobby chef is portrayed: a “Basler Bebbi”, as it is in the textbook, Fasnachtler and FCB fan. All peace, joy, pancakes, you could think. If there was no diagnosis of multiple sclerosis that Philipp Kunz received six years ago. However, he cannot get it down by the disease. / Vor zwolf Jahren steckte seine linke Zehe in den Stacheln des giftigsten Fisches Europas, im Petermannchen. Heute nun ubt Philipp Kunz aus Munchenstein BL verspatete Rache an dieser Spezies und serviert sie seinen vier Mitstreitern – zum Hauptgang notabene. Aufgetischt bekommen sie die Petermannchen naturlich ohne die giftigen Ruckenstacheln, dafur garniert mit Erinnerungen an die schmerzhaften Badeferien in Frankreich.Philipp Kunz ist der Ehrgeizige im Team. Nur eine Kaseplatte oder ein Stuck Fleisch, das der Gast als Zumutung noch selber braten muss, kommen bei ihm nicht auf den Tisch. Self-made ist seine Devise, und da lasst sich der Projektleiter eines Telekommunikationsunternehmens so einiges einfallen: Sei es die leichte Curry-Zitronengras-Suppe neben dem Tatar aus Bundnerfleisch, das Cicorino-rosso-Risotto, das Rosmarin-Parfait oder die hausgemachten Florentiner. Mit dem Vorsatz «Der Gewinner bin ich» stellt sich der 46-jahrige Baselbieter an den Herd – gut vorbereitet mit all seinen Notizen und Zeichnungen. Ist darauf aber auch wirklich alles notiert?Die vierte Folge von «SRF bi de Lut - Mannerkuche» wird es zeigen. Portratiert wird ein ambitionierter Hobbykoch: ein «Basler Bebbi», wie er im Lehrbuch steht, Fasnachtler und FCB-Fan. Alles Friede, Freude, Eierkuchen, konnte man meinen.
